item.description:
This version of the Execute API only performs one calculation for a given Spark service from a platform standpoint. There are use cases (such as PDF Reporting, Data Connectors, Traffic Directors) where more than one operation happen behind the scenes, however, this is still considered ONE calculation because the model (aka WASM module) is only run once and can be viewed in API Call History if enabled.

Check out the [API Reference](https://docs.coherent.global/spark-apis/execute-api/execute-api-v3) to learn more.

item.name: v4
locators
item.description:
When enabled, all these endpoints can be publicly accessed if the `/public` is part of path and precedes the `/execute`: `BASE_URL/api/v4` + `/public` + `/execute`.

For example:

`https://excel.my-env.coherent.global/my-tenant/api/v4/public/execute`.

item.description:
This version of the Execute API can perform one or more WASM module calculations in sequence behind the scenes, which saves travel time.

A clear tradeoff is that some metadata-flagged operations are no longer valid due to its multipicilty nature.

Check out the [API Reference](https://docs.coherent.global/spark-apis/execute-api/execute-api-v4) to learn more.
